classes.meaning: Value copied verbatim from a canonical owner decision source.
validationRules: sourceJsonPointer must resolve in the pinned owner decision
replayed value must equal the target value

classes.meaning: Value derived from a canonical GENESIS_IMPORT ledger event.
validationRules: sourceJsonPointer must resolve inside the NDJSON event index

classes.meaning: Value derived from the canonical gate registry order or its fallback policy.
validationRules: sourceJsonPointer must resolve in the pinned gate registry
derivation must be replayable from the resolved value

classes.meaning: Value whose admissibility rests on an explicit project owner policy decision rather than on historical evidence.
validationRules: the referenced owner policy must explicitly authorize the target pointer
the policy value must not be presented as historical

classes.meaning: Reference to an explicitly declared external authority, resolved by exact SHA-256 with no synthetic fallback.
validationRules: declared sha256 must equal the real bytes of the pinned external report
no implicit resolution by name or probable path

classes.meaning: Explanatory value produced by a registered derived rule to state that history is unknown. Never a recovered historical source.
validationRules: must carry a rulePointer instead of a source document pointer

classes.meaning: Per-branch constant ratified by the pinned R1 reconstruction rule body. Structural, not gate-specific, and never a historical observation.
validationRules: the branch constant must resolve at an exact pointer inside the pinned R1 rule body
the branch must be selected from event.authorityPath alone
the constant must never be presented as historical evidence

classes.meaning: Value that identifies the reconstruction itself rather than any historical fact.
validationRules: reconstructionRuleId must equal the pinned rule id

purpose: Closed set of semantic classes. Every provenance row must reference a registered semanticClassId whose permitted sources and permitted transformations both admit that row.
